title: Software and subscription pricing transparency: a sourced, dated dataset across 133 categories
description: An independent, methodologically documented pricing-transparency dataset spanning 133 software, SaaS and consumer-subscription categories (1,000+ vendors, 3,600+ plan records) — from CRM, web hosting, observability and developer infrastructure to VPNs, streaming, AI tools and business banking. Built for price-transparency research and reproducibility: every figure is traced to its primary source (the vendor's own page URL and the date it was captured) and, where possible, corroborated by a second independent source. Quote-only and enterprise tiers are recorded with a null price rather than a guessed value. Selected categories also carry verified product facts beyond price — HIPAA/SOC 2/GDPR compliance, free-tier availability, usage limits, key integrations and differentiating features — each with its own provenance. A documented normalization methodology converts heterogeneous published prices to a common monthly basis while preserving the raw figure. Machine-readable distributions (flat CSV and JSON Lines, a schema.org DataCatalog manifest, and per-category JSON) accompany the data. Canonical, continuously updated version and full methodology: https://frontdeskreview.com/data
